response.justification: Bogdan is a talented full-stack and systems engineer with a long, diverse career, but the role calls for a Director-level Principal Engineer driving AI strategy with recognized AI expertise, demonstrated AI products, and experience advising strategic customers on cutting-edge AI/cloud adoption. His resume shows only a few months of AI-agent tooling work (MCP code generators) at his current role, no cloud specialization, no AI-related advanced degree, and no evidence of strategic advisory, executive-level influence, or building AI platforms at scale. His trajectory and titles (Senior/Staff Developer) also don't match the seniority and scope expected for this Director-level IC position.
strengths: 15+ years of broad, hands-on engineering experience across web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure
Entrepreneurial mindset shown through founding and maintaining an open-source geo-data platform (GISCollective)
History of knowledge-sharing via talks, workshops, and community teaching, indicating some ability to inspire others
concerns: Virtually no demonstrated AI/ML expertise or track record of building recognized AI products/platforms
No advanced degree or specialized training in AI, and no cloud-strategy focused experience
Career level (Senior/Staff Developer) and role scope don't align with the Director-level, strategy-advising Principal Engineer position

key_factors.factor: Seniority/scope mismatch (IC vs Director-level strategy role)
